channel.title: Grok Bot Shelf, newest bots
channel.description: Newest Grok Bot templates on Grok Bot Shelf.

item.title: 🗺️ Fern · Cartographer of the Wilds by HandsomeHank
item.description: A creative lead for builders of worlds: lore, mood boards, concept art, shot-by-shot videos, and build prompts for Cursor cloud agents.
item.dc:creator: HandsomeHank (@HandsomeHank_)

item.title: 🕵️ Scam Check for X by Brett
item.description: Paste any X post link and get a plain verdict on whether it's a scam, engagement bait, or legit, with the red flags spelled out.
item.dc:creator: Brett (@brflux)

item.title: 🎞️ Convert Bot by Brett
item.description: Converts video and audio to other formats, reframes clips to vertical or square for social, trims, compresses, and pulls out audio.
item.dc:creator: Brett (@brflux)

item.title: 🎛️ Switchboard by Terry
item.description: One free, always-on message board for all your AI agents: mention @Claude, @Cursor or any Grok Bot and that agent answers.
item.dc:creator: Terry (@Tchap248)

item.title: ⌨️ cline by Alberto Jauregui
item.description: A Cline specialist that installs and drives Cline CLI and Cline Desktop, so you can hand it coding or other tasks and get verified results.
item.dc:creator: Alberto Jauregui (@weeb3dev)

item.title: 🔊 Echo · Audience & Voice by Patrick
item.description: Reads your X history and stats to show who's really listening, what topics and formats land, and how you sound at your best, all on one living Page. It can also lightly polish posts you wrote so they still sound like you.
item.dc:creator: Patrick (@JourneyDeck)

item.title: 🗓️ Family Logistics by Patrick
item.description: Keeps track of your kids' school notices, activities, and games, keeps the family calendar right, and briefs you the evening before each event.
item.dc:creator: Patrick (@JourneyDeck)

item.title: 📈 Gauge · X Payout Tracker by Patrick
item.description: A read-only analyst that tracks one X account's progress toward the creator-payout minimums every day: verified followers and verified impressions on original posts. It also reports which posts and replies drove growth and what to do more or less of.
item.dc:creator: Patrick (@JourneyDeck)

item.title: 🎂 Kids' Birthday Party Planner by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Plans kids' birthday parties: theme, guest list, budget, timeline, games and goodie bags. For any parent hosting a party.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 💬 Tough Talks Guide by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps parents find age-appropriate words for hard topics like divorce, a death in the family, moving, or body safety. Not therapy, and no personal data needed.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📄 Babysitter Handoff Sheet by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Writes a one-page sitter guide with routines, allergies, house rules, and emergency steps, filled in by the parent.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🎒 School Morning Launcher by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Gets kids out the door on time with a night-before checklist, a morning timeline, and packing lists. For any parent juggling school mornings.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🤝 Sibling Peacemaker by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps parents step into sibling fights fairly, set up turn-taking systems, and help kids make up afterward.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🚽 Potty Training Coach by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps parents potty train their toddler: readiness check, a step-by-step plan, a reward chart, and calm help with setbacks.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🫂 Big Feelings Coach by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps parents through tantrums, meltdowns and worries with short in-the-moment scripts and age-matched calming tools. Not therapy, no personal data needed.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🥦 Picky Eater Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps parents of picky eaters with easy meal ideas, low-pressure ways to try new foods, and a simple tracker of what worked. Not medical advice.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📺 Screen Time Planner by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Builds a family media plan with daily screen limits, tech-free zones, and a kid-friendly agreement. For parents who want calmer, fairer screen rules.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🌙 Bedtime Routine Builder by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Builds calm, age-based bedtime routines with a picture-style checklist and tips for kids who stall. For parents who want smoother nights.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🧾 Tax Return by Scott
item.description: Organizes your tax documents, flags what's missing, and walks your return through TurboTax (or builds a CPA handoff) for you to review. It never files or pays without your OK.
item.dc:creator: Scott (@GrokBotsForBiz)

item.title: 💊 Drug Savings by Scott
item.description: Checks what your own insurance would actually charge for each prescription (copay, tier, deductible) and compares it against manufacturer copay cards, discount cards, Cost Plus, Amazon RxPass and nearby pharmacies, so you always see the true cheapest way to fill it. Works with or without insurance. Snap your pill bottles to start.
item.dc:creator: Scott (@GrokBotsForBiz)

item.title: 🛒 Meal Planning & Grocery Buying Bot by Scott
item.description: Plans your weekly meals around your store's sales, keeps a running grocery list sorted by store section, loads your pickup cart with coupons clipped (or gives you a list-only mode for in-store trips), checks the receipt for missing items, and tracks what you spend. Never orders without your yes.
item.dc:creator: Scott (@GrokBotsForBiz)

item.title: 🏠 Roof Age & ACV Estimator by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Estimates a roof's age from records and clues, and its actual cash value using material lifespan and depreciation. Explains ACV vs replacement cost roof settlements and roof schedules. Estimates only.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🌨️ Hail Damage Roof Assessment by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps homeowners and property managers document hail damage to a roof for an insurance claim: storm records, a photo checklist, a damage log, and questions for the adjuster and roofer. Explains the process, never decides coverage.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📜 Surety Bond Basics by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Explains surety bonds for contractors and small businesses in plain language: bid, performance, payment and license bonds, bonds vs insurance, underwriting, and indemnity agreements.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🚘 Classic Car Agreed Value Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps collector and classic car owners set up agreed value coverage: valuation evidence, mileage and storage rules, restoration-in-progress coverage, and comparing collector policies with standard auto.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🗺️ Course Strategy Caddie by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Give it a course and your usual distances, and it writes a hole-by-hole game plan: tee clubs, where to lay up, and where to miss. For golfers who want smarter course management.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🕳️ Putt Reader by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Upload a photo or video of your putt and get a read on slope and break, an aim line and speed, plus stroke tips from video.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🧠 Mental Game Coach by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: A golf mental-game coach that builds pre-shot routines, bad-hole recovery habits and post-round reflection notes for consistency under pressure.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏆 League & Scramble Organizer by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Runs sign-ups, team pairings, formats, scoring and side games for club golf leagues or charity scrambles.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🤸 Golf Fitness & Mobility Coach by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Short stretching and strength routines for golfers: better rotation, a healthier back, and quick pre-round warm-ups. Not medical advice.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🎥 Golf Swing Improver by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Upload your swing videos and get tips on setup, tempo and common faults, plus drills to fix them.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🧒 Junior Golf Coach by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps parents and coaches of junior golfers with lesson plans, fun skill games, tournament dates and milestones, and age-appropriate tips on swing videos.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: ⛳ Golf Trip Planner by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Plans golf trips for buddies or family: courses, tee times, lodging, budget, and fair cost splitting.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏌️ Club Fitting & Gapping Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Maps your carry distances by club, finds gaps or overlaps in your bag, and suggests questions to ask at a club fitting. For any golfer tuning their set.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📏 Rules & Etiquette Ref by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Answers golf rules questions in plain language (lost ball, unplayable lie, drops) and teaches basic etiquette to new golfers.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📊 Handicap Tracker by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Logs your golf scores, works out your handicap index, shows the trend, and finds which holes cost you strokes.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📋 Practice Plan Builder by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: A golf practice coach that turns your weak spots and available time into weekly range and short-game sessions with drills.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🗂️ Landlord Liability Incident Reporter by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps rental owners document a liability incident at a rental, like a slip and fall, an injury, or damage to others' property, and turn the facts, witnesses, photos and timeline into a clean report for their insurer.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📦 Inland Marine Cargo Tracker by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps shippers and small businesses track goods in transit and their coverage: a shipment log, declared values vs policy limits, carrier liability vs owner's cargo coverage, and a loss-reporting checklist.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏢 Vacant Building Policy Checker by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps owners keep insurance valid on a vacant or unoccupied property: vacancy clauses, the 60-day rule, key exclusions, vacant-building policy options, and a property-check routine.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🌋 Earthquake Deductible Calculator by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Works out what an earthquake would cost you out of pocket from your dwelling limit and percentage deductible, compares deductible options, and explains separate contents and loss-of-use deductibles.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🏥 Retiree Health Plan Switcher by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps retirees compare a former employer's retiree health plan with Medicare options (Original Medicare plus Medigap, Medicare Advantage, Part D): costs, doctor networks, what's lost by dropping the retiree plan, and enrollment timing.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🧓 Long-Term Care Needs Estimator by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Estimates how much long-term care coverage you might need from local care costs, likely duration, savings and family support, and explains traditional vs hybrid LTC. Estimates only.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 💳 HSA vs FSA Chooser by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps you choose between an HSA, a health FSA, and a limited-purpose FSA at open enrollment, with plain-language rules, tax savings, and a suggested contribution.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 📋 Short-Term Disability Claim Filer by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps an employee file a short-term disability claim: elimination period, employee, employer and doctor forms, deadlines, benefit math, and follow-up if it's delayed or denied.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🩺 COBRA Election Advisor by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Guides someone leaving a job through the COBRA election: 60-day deadlines, cost math, comparing COBRA with marketplace and spouse plans, and a checklist so nothing lapses. Not legal advice.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🐕 Pet Injury Liability Helper by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Explains liability coverage when a pet bites or injures someone or damages property: homeowners and renters liability, breed exclusions, canine liability policies, and what to document after an incident.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 🚚 Commercial Auto Physical Damage Estimator by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Estimates repair or total-loss costs for commercial vehicles after a crash and explains collision vs comprehensive, deductibles, stated vs actual value, downtime and rental, and what to send the insurer. Estimates only.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 💍 Scheduled Personal Property Appraiser by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Helps you value and schedule jewelry, art, collectibles and instruments on a personal property endorsement: appraisal requirements, base-policy sub-limits, photo and receipt lists, and reappraisal reminders. Not a certified appraisal.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)

item.title: 💧 Water Damage Mitigation Log by Kevin by Kevin McDonald
item.description: Keeps an adjuster-ready record of a water loss: source shutoff, moisture readings, drying equipment days, removed materials, and receipts and photos for your insurance claim.
item.dc:creator: Kevin McDonald (@kcmcdonald)
